architecture_and_inference: identical to phase1; 16NFE; unchanged noise/path/condition/frozen residual base
initialization: original v2 selected weight, not phase1 loss-tuned weight; isolate actual-output training
controls: reuse audited phase1 continue runs when all settings match; otherwise train identical native-loss control

auxiliary.sampled_objective: phase1 clean_objective balanced on actual 16-step sampled prediction
auxiliary.noise_rng: separate seeded CUDA generator; saved/restored; leaves native training RNG unchanged

selection: same fixed validation screen768 then top2 fullvalidation plus original epoch0; CSI primary and POD/FAR/FSS tie-break

confirmation.gate: CSI gain >.003 vs original; POD >=original-.03; FAR <=original+.03; RMSE <=1.1 original

report: all20lead curves, 3thresholds,4fixed members,no best-of-N,actual prediction images and comparison with phase1 winner

storage.save: checkpoints plus 72h-block metric sums and selected case fields

dependency: phase1 analysis completed and independently audited before new training
test: no test evaluation or tuning; historical test periods previously viewed
